description: Figure 4 is a vertical bar chart titled “Runtime Comparison of Models in Streaming Environment,” which visually compares the runtime in seconds for “Our joint Framework” against five “LLM Models” — ChatGPT, DeepSeek, LLaMA, and Claude — on the SEconvo dataset. The horizontal axis lists the six models as categories, with “Our joint Framework” positioned at the leftmost end. The vertical axis, labeled “Runtime (seconds),” uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 400 seconds, with major gridlines and tick marks at intervals of 50 seconds. The chart employs a legend indicating that “Our joint Framework” is represented by a solid green bar, while “LLM Models” are represented by solid light blue bars. The bar for “Our joint Framework” has a value of 77 seconds. The bars for the LLM models are labeled with their respective runtime values: ChatGPT at 190 seconds, DeepSeek at 365 seconds, LLaMA at 172 seconds, and Claude at 243 seconds. The bars are arranged in the order of the model names along the horizontal axis and are not sorted by value. No bars are visually emphasized with special formatting such as shading or bolding.
